title: xo projects registry (<XO root>/.xo/projects.json)
description: Authoritative list of the projects under `projects_root`, written by the watcher's workspace tier (services/cowork_agent/visualizer/workspace/projects_json.py). Replaces the retired `workspace.json`, whose payload was a bare array of directory names. One entry per directory `list_project_ids()` reports — scaffolded or not — keyed by the directory name, which is the id every route, graph node and backup repository already uses. `pid` is a first-class field rather than the key: a JSON object cannot have a null key and every project is pid-less at birth, and duplicate pids are a real, silent state (`cp -r`, and restore, both copy `.xo/project.json` verbatim).

projects_root.description: Absolute path to the xo-projects root (typically ~/xo-projects). Stored for the watcher; stripped before any BFF response.

pid.description: The identity that survives a rename, a clone and a restore. Null until the watcher's identity fill mints one, and permanently null for a folder that is never scaffolded.

is_repo.description: Whether the folder is the root of its OWN repository. A plain folder nested inside a larger checkout is false — it must not inherit the enclosing repository's remote.

remote_url.description: remote.origin.url with any userinfo stripped. Null when there is no repository, no remote, or no git.

default_branch.description: Read offline from refs/remotes/origin/HEAD, falling back to the current branch. Null on a detached HEAD with no origin HEAD.

by_pid.description: DERIVED reverse index, rebuilt from `projects` in the same pass — never edited independently. Values are ALWAYS arrays: one pid in two folders is a real, reachable state and losing a folder is not an option, so a length above 1 IS the duplicate-pid alarm. A null pid, or one that fails the key charset clamp, is simply absent.
